title: Order totals always come back as $0 plus shipping
body: Reported by customer Dana Whitfield (dana.whitfield@acmemail.com, 555-867-5309). Dana says: 'I placed a three-item order and the confirmation said my total was $5.00. My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 shows the same. You basically gave me the stuff for free?' - Investigation: create_order validates the payload items but never attaches them to the Order, so every order is empty and the total is just the flat shipping fee.

acceptance_criteria.text: Line items from the request payload are attached to the created order.
The order total in the create_order response reflects the submitted items.
A regression test covers order creation with items.
